reference.title: Permissions
reference.shortdesc: The app asks for each permission only when you first use the feature that needs it. Setup asks for none.

row.entry: Permission
What it's for, in the app's words
When it's asked
Bluetooth
Bluetooth lets OMNI notice people in the same place as you who also have the app. No internet needed.
When you turn on Nearby.
Local Network
This lets phones in the same place talk to each other directly, even with no Wi-Fi or mobile data.
Right after Bluetooth.
Notifications
While OMNI is open, we'll play a sound and show a banner when someone says hi.
The first time someone appears on Nearby, or before your first hi.
Location (while using the app)
Your location is used to leave a note at a place for someone you matched with, and to find notes left for you when you get there.
When you leave a note, or open Notes with a note waiting.
Microphone
The microphone is used only during a voice call with someone you matched with.
Your first call.
Camera
Take a photo for your profile, a story or a post, or scan a friend's code to add them.
When you take a photo or scan a code.
Photos
Choose a photo for your profile, a story or a post.
When you choose from your library.
